title: Gemma 3 Release
summary: Google's Gemma release documentation records the release of Gemma 3 on March 10, 2025, in 1B, 4B, 12B, and 27B parameter sizes.
significance: A dated release milestone in Google's Gemma family of open models.

verification.note: Google AI for Developers' first-party Gemma releases documentation explicitly records March 10, 2025 as the release date for Gemma 3 in 1B, 4B, 12B and 27B sizes.
